John Jones, who last year threw almost as well as Dick Harris, took his place and while not at his best got fifth place with 44'0" in the Shot.
Seventy-six runners were started on their way by Arthur Whitehead's "Atomic Device" and soon afterwards Jones of Southend was seen to be leading from Eric Gebbett.

Charlie Jones, as expected, gained a victory in both the sprints and was also placed 3rd in the Long Jump. Gerry Leroy ran very well in the half-mile to take 3rd place - he must have done his best ever.
In the junior match our best performance was by Stan Black who ran third in the half mile to Jones of S.L.H.(2m.1.2s.) and Hamilton of Hercules(2m.3.2s.); the latter just pipping Stan on the line.
